fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Al-Sayed and I live at 824 Juniper Way, Ashland, OR 97548. You can reach me on (555) 764-1688 or dmitri.alsayed@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 19 February 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00145. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Al-Sayed on (555) 764-1688 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 19 February 2024.
Site visit to 824 Juniper Way. Neighbour Samuel Whitlock was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
